Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
About the Role 
 We are looking for a Python Backend Developer to build and extend the backend of an internal developer portal and dashboard, using AI coding tools in daily work.
 The mandatory requirements are 4+ years of backend development with Python and FastAPI, Django, or Flask , experience with Snowflake, SQL, and NoSQL databases, REST API design, Git and CI/CD, daily use of AI coding assistants, and an upper-intermediate English level.
 What you will do 
Continue the development and extension of the internal developer portal and dashboard.
Design, build, and maintain a robust custom Python backend to support core application features.
Leverage AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) to streamline implementation, refactoring, and test generation.
Integrate the application with diverse database environments, specifically Snowflake, relational (SQL), and non-relational (NoSQL) databases.
Manage version control and CI/CD pipelines (Git) to maintain automated testing and smooth deployment workflows.
Interact with and navigate Linux/Unix environments on a user level to run development builds, execute scripts, and inspect logs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate user requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Ensure code quality through unit testing, peer code reviews, and performance optimization.
 Must haves 
 Python Expertise: Strong hands-on backend development experience of at least 4 years using Python and standard web frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Django, or Flask ).
 AI Tooling: Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants in daily development workflows.
 Version Control & CI/CD: Proficiency with Git , including branch management, pull requests, and CI/CD pipeline integration.
 Linux/Unix Fundamentals: User-level proficiency with Linux/Unix command-line navigation, shell scripting basics, and environment manipulation (no administrative/sysadmin duties required).
 Database Integration: Experience working with diverse databases, including Snowflake , relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL), and non-relational (e.g., MongoDB) databases.
 API Design: Solid understanding of RESTful API design principles and integration.
Upper-intermediate English level.
 Nice to haves 
Familiarity with modern frontend development (TypeScript or modern component-based frameworks like React/Vue) for cross-stack collaboration.
Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
Experience working within an Agile/Scrum development lifecycle.
 Perks 
 Growth without limits: build your skills through mentorship, internal TechTalks, challenging projects, and a dedicated annual learning budget
 Competitive compensation: get recognition that reflects your skills and impact, with regular performance and compensation reviews
 Flexibility: work 100% remotely with flexible hours that support focus, autonomy, and a healthy work rhythm
 Meaningful, modern projects: build impactful products using modern technologies alongside global teams and leading brands
 Collaborative culture: join a supportive environment with zero micromanagement where ideas are welcomed and contributions are recognized
 Well-being & support: access local well-being programs and people-focused support tailored to your location
